site.name: Diriyah, At-Turaif
site.notes: heavy_rain_days_per_year = 1.91, computed from Open-Meteo ERA5 (2015-2025) with an ASSUMED 10 mm/day threshold (hadaq_sim.cli rain-frequency). demo_storm_date = the real past storm we replay, picked from the wettest days (hadaq_sim.cli storms). ERA5 is a reanalysis, not a station measurement.

building.name: Focus building (palace model at the At-Turaif placeholder spot)
building.notes: 3D model: 'Diriyah Palace Founding Day' by mohamed (@almehmadi_sa), CC BY 4.0, an AI-generated (Meshy) model, not a survey. Placed at a placeholder spot in At-Turaif; real scan of this building is Round 2. Scale ASSUMED 31.25 m per model unit (25 m plus 25% for presence). osm_element_id stays null: the focus building is found by location (40 m around the wall).

walls.name: Main facade, street-level front wall
walls.notes: Front wall of the palace model (about 33 m wide, 7.2 m tall at the assumed scale). azimuth_deg = direction the facade faces. start = LEFT end when you face the facade (column C1). Move the building by changing base_line and azimuth_deg together; the model follows the middle of base_line.

zones.cols_counted_from: left, standing in front of the facade

cameras.notes: wall_bbox_px = [x0, y0, x1, y1] of the wall face inside the photo. Abdurhmn sets it from the real photo series.
